PR (cited in the notes as #16846): feat: add AND operator opt-in option for sync windows matches [closed]
Resolves https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/issues/6110

Currently, the sync windows configuration is using an OR operator while filtering the apps based on `applications`, `namespaces` and `clusters`. The sync windows UI is a bit counter intuitive when it comes to how the sync options are going to consumed. The natural way when you have exposed multiple configs is to have them ANDed. So if I set both the `applications` and `clusters` configs, I expect they will match only those apps that…

filters, in other words the intersection between the sync windows list selected based on applications filter and the sync windows list selected based on clusters filter.

This PR is switching the sync windows apps selection from OR operation to AND operation.
